text:
Type: metal wall shelf with back rail
Use: holding books, toiletries, spices or small decor; living room, kitchen, bathroom, home office
Style: minimalist, modern, industrial
Materials: aluminium-colored metal with a matte finish
Colors: silver grey, light cool grey
Shape: L-shaped profile with a flat shelf and a low upright back panel, crisp straight edges, slim and flush to the wall, compact and light
Feel: sleek, cool, tidy, understated
Goes with: white walls, glass, chrome, grey or black accents; modern, minimalist or industrial rooms

product.name: LIMHAMN
product.description: Shelves in stainless steel, a hygienic, strong and durable material that is easy to keep clean.
